meta.note: Keyed by question id, mirroring reviews/data/samples.json so the sample page needs no genre-specific reader. Only 'default' exists so far — alternative1/alternative2 are not yet written, and the reader falls back to default. Extracted verbatim from the inline SAMPLES const in article-sample.html.

default.label: Opening
sentences: If you could be famous for anything in the world, what would you choose?
It's a question that tells you more about a person than almost any other.

default.label: Development 1
sentences: As far as I'm concerned, being famous for scientific discovery would be the greatest achievement imaginable.
One of the key things I love about science is how a single idea can change millions of lives.
Sometimes this happens long after the scientist is gone.
Take Marie Curie, for example.
She is famous not for being famous, but for what she gave the world.

default.label: Development 2
sentences: On top of that, this kind of fame inspires others.
Every famous scientist probably encourages dozens of young people to follow the same path.

default.label: Closing
sentences: To sum up, the best kind of fame comes from making a real difference.
Whatever you think of my choice, one thing is clear: the fame worth having means leaving something good behind.

For me, the answer has always been the same: Sintra, a small town tucked into the hills just outside Lisbon.

default.label: Development 1

You can wander through royal gardens, stumble upon hidden chapels, and stop at a small café for a warm pastry, all within an hour.
Apart from its beauty, another thing that really stands out is how accessible it is — just forty minutes by train from Lisbon.

default.label: Opening
sentences: Why do so many students find it so difficult to stay healthy?
With classes, homework and a busy social life, it can feel almost impossible.
But a few small changes really do make a big difference.

topic.frame: Why do so many people attach such importance to

default.label: Development 1
sentences: What makes the biggest difference, in my experience, is routine.
One of the key things I've learned is that proper meals are better than snacks.
They give you more energy, and your brain works better too.
If you often skip breakfast, try preparing something simple the night before.

topic.frame: One of the key things I love about

default.label: Development 2
sentences: Apart from diet, another thing that really stands out is the power of walking.
You don't need a gym.
Walking to school, taking the stairs or spending twenty minutes outside at lunchtime can really change your mood.

default.label: Closing
sentences: All in all, staying healthy as a student isn't about big, expensive changes.
Whether you start with sleep, food or exercise, small steps every day really add up.
